form.urlHint: A public https:// address. Private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full web address, such as https://example.com/hooks.

secret.warning: You won't see this secret again. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe.
secret.usage: Verify each delivery's webhook-signature with it (Standard Webhooks). After a rotation, the old secret keeps signing next to it for 24 hours.
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.
secret.label: Signing secret

detail.title: Endpoint
detail.testSent: Test event sent: see it in the deliveries.
detail.rotateDescription: A new secret is made and shown once. The old one keeps signing next to it for 24 hours, so your receiver can switch over.
detail.deleteDescription: It stops receiving events at once, and its deliveries are no longer shown. This can't be undone.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: What was sent to this endpoint, newest first. Open one to see the request and the response.

delivery.title: Delivery
